lines.en: I tap on Maya’s name in my phone and think about how many other versions of me have been able to narrate that.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Maya 的名字，想着究竟有多少个版本的我曾经有机会这样叙述过这件事。

lines.en: Sure, it may have taken the end of several worlds (Or several ends of one world) for me to {i}be able{/i} to share something like this with you, but...I’m here.
lines.zh: 诚然，或许要走到数个世界的尽头（或者同一个世界数次的终结），我才{i}有资格{/i}与你分享这样一件事，但是……我在这里了。

lines.en: And hopefully soon, she will be as well.
lines.zh: 而希望很快，她也会在这里。

lines.en: As I stare down at a name that is perhaps the most important to me (Barring the recent intrusion of another girl I’ve known for far too long), I think about what I’m going to say when she picks up.
lines.zh: 我低头盯着这个对我而言或许最为重要的名字（暂且不论最近闯进来的那个我认识了太久太久的女孩），思考着她接起电话时我该说些什么。
但随后她接了起来。

lines.en: And I still have absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: 而我依然完全没有准备。

lines.en: : You realize you’re suppose to say words after you call someone, correct?
lines.zh: : 你应该知道，给人打电话之后是要说话的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...what are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你现在在做什么？

lines.en: : I don’t want to answer that question.
lines.zh: : 我不想回答这个问题。
: 为什么不？

lines.en: : Because it will be succeeded by an invitation to wherever you are right now.
lines.zh: : 因为紧接着就会是一句「来你现在在的地方」的邀请。
: 那又怎样？
: 那又怎样……

lines.en: : I, depressingly, don’t think I’d be able to say no.
lines.zh: : 而我很可悲地觉得，我大概说不出口拒绝。

lines.en: : Let’s meet at my apartment, then.
lines.zh: : 那就在我公寓见面吧。

lines.en: : We still haven’t talked and I don’t want to just pretend that what happened on the beach was some spur of the moment mistake.
lines.zh: : 我们还没谈过，而且我不想就这么假装海滩上发生的事是一时冲动的错误。

lines.en: : I’m tired of collecting dust. And you said it yourself that you also hate how stagnant things have become.
lines.zh: : 我厌倦了一直积灰。而且你自己也说过，你也讨厌事情变得这么停滞不前。
: 我不——

lines.en: : I get that it’s probably terrifying having to confront your feelings after all of this time. It’s terrifying for {i}me{/i} and I’ve only been doing this for what equates to, like...two or three years.
lines.zh: : 我知道，在过了这么久之后要直面自己的感情，大概很可怕。就连{i}我{/i}也觉得可怕，而我只做了相当于……两三年而已。

lines.en: : But is there really any point in {i}anything{/i} you’ve done if neither one of us ever gets what we want?
lines.zh: : 但如果我们两个永远都得不到自己想要的东西，你所做的一切又有{i}什么{/i}意义呢？

lines.en: : {i}I don’t know.{/i} That’s the whole problem and it’s exactly what I’ve been trying to tell you this whole time.
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道{/i}。这正是问题所在，也是我从一开始就想告诉你的事。

lines.en: : Then tell me in a way that’s easier to understand.
lines.zh: : 那就用一种更容易理解的方式告诉我。

lines.en: : I’m...{i}bad{/i} at that. I don’t like talking. Especially about sappy, childish stuff like {i}romance{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我……{i}不擅长{/i}这个。我不喜欢说话。尤其是关于{i}恋爱{/i}这种肉麻又幼稚的东西。

lines.en: : You can carry on a conversation about time or the stars for days.
lines.zh: : 关于时间或者星星，你能连着聊上几天。

lines.en: : Talking about those things has never broken the world.
lines.zh: : 聊那些东西从来没有把世界弄坏过。
: 那聊我们就会？

lines.en: : Have you not been paying attention to literally anything I’ve been telling you over the last “two or three years?” {i}Yes.{/i} Things have spiraled into chaos {i}every other time{/i} I have done that.
lines.zh: : 你是完全没有在听我这「两三年」以来跟你说的任何一句话吗？{i}会{/i}。我{i}每次{/i}这么做，事情都陷入了混乱。

lines.en: : This time is different and you know it.
lines.zh: : 这次不一样，你心里清楚。
: 我知道……
: 所以我才这么小心翼翼。

lines.en: : Just come over. And don’t bring Ayane this time, even if she's still glued to you.
lines.zh: : 过来就是了。而且这次别带 Ayane，就算她还黏着你。

lines.en: : Good idea. Wouldn’t want you getting distracted and having sex with her while we’re trying to talk.
lines.zh: : 好主意。可不能在我们谈话的时候让你分心，跟她做起爱来。
: Maya-

lines.en: : I’ll stop at the convenience store. Is there anything you want?
lines.zh: : 我会顺路去趟便利店。有什么想要的吗？
: 什么时候？现在？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m on my way over so we can {i}talk{/i} if that will get you to stop bothering me about this every time we communicate.
lines.zh: : 对。我正往你那边走，我们好{i}把话说清楚{/i}，这样你就不用每次联系我都来烦我了。
: 可是 Sensei——

lines.en: : Call me by my real name.
lines.zh: : 用我的真名称呼我。

lines.en: There’s a silence at the other end of the phone.
lines.zh: 电话那头是一阵沉默。
然后是一声提示音。

lines.en: One hour later, she shows up at my apartment with plastic bags clasped in each of her hands.
lines.zh: 一个小时后，她出现在我的公寓门口，两只手各拎着几个塑料袋。

lines.en: She takes her shoes off at the entrance and I meet her at the door.
lines.zh: 她在玄关脱下鞋，我到门口迎她。

lines.en: When she steps toward me, she feels shorter than normal.
lines.zh: 她朝我走过来的时候，感觉比平时要矮。

lines.en: I don’t know if it’s the lack of shoes or the mutual desire to hold one another that’s making her feel so much more fragile than normal but, unlike the others, I have no intention of breaking this one.
lines.zh: 我不知道是因为没穿鞋，还是因为彼此都想拥抱对方，才让她显得比平时脆弱得多——但和别人不同，我并不打算把这个弄坏。
: 你挂我电话了。

lines.en: : I did not. You dropped a bomb on me and I died.
lines.zh: : 我没有。你给我扔了颗炸弹，然后我死了。

lines.en: : You’re pretty attractive for a dead girl, you know.
lines.zh: : 作为一个死掉的女孩，你还挺好看的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Great. One more disgusting fetish to add to the list. Thank you for complicating things within seconds of my arrival. I expected nothing less.
lines.zh: : 好极了。又能往名单上加一个恶心的癖好了。谢谢你在我到达几秒内就把事情变复杂。我本来就没指望别的。
: Maya-
: 什么时候？
: 哈？什么时候什么？
: 你是什么时候想起来的？
: 我没有。
: 是 Niki 告诉我的。

lines.en: : Those {i}fucking{/i} Nakayamas will never stop being problematic. It’s an actual miracle you’re still here to talk about this when you could have been wiped right then and there.
lines.zh: : 那群{i}该死的{/i} Nakayama 家的人永远不会停止制造麻烦。你本该在那一瞬间就被抹掉，如今还能站在这里谈这些，简直是个奇迹。

lines.en: : There seem to be a lot of miracles lately. And you can add to that list by joining those {i}fucking Nakayamas{/i} in calling me by my actual name.
lines.zh: : 最近奇迹似乎挺多的。而你可以再添一个——加入那群{i}该死的 Nakayama{/i}，用我的真名来称呼我。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s...it’s not as if I don’t {i}want{/i} to call you by your actual name...it just feels...wrong after all this time. And I’ve already gotten used to “Sensei,” so...
lines.zh: : 我是说……不是我{i}不想{/i}想用真名称呼你……只是过了这么久，感觉……怪怪的。而且我已经习惯「Sensei」了，所以……
: 你是害羞了吧？

lines.en: : Possibly. But I’m also taking into consideration the fact that you short-circuited from just touching me a while ago.
lines.zh: : 有可能。但我同时也考虑到，你前阵子光是碰到我就短路了。

lines.en: : And also how hearing something as important as your name from the girl more suited to you than {i}anyone{/i} might be a little more intense than hearing it from some shitty idol and her sister.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，从那个比我身边{i}任何人{/i}都更配得上你的女孩嘴里听到像你名字这么重要的东西，可能会比从某个糟糕偶像和她妹妹那里听到要强烈得多。
: Niki 是个好人，Maya。

lines.en: : I don’t care. Things would be easier if she didn’t exist, so I will continue to want her to...not exist.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。如果她不存在，事情会简单得多，所以我会继续希望她……不存在。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m hungry and I’m going to be eating now. I got you something too. Eat it or don’t. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 总之，我饿了，现在要吃了。我也给你带了。吃不吃随你。我不在乎。

lines.en: : You know, I {i}knew{/i} you were tsundere this whole time but you kept denying it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我{i}早就知道{/i}你一直是个傲娇，可你偏不承认。

lines.en: : You don’t know anything! I’m the one who knows stuff! Now shut up and leave me alone!
lines.zh: : 你什么都不知道！知道事情的人是我！现在闭嘴，别烦我！

lines.en: Maya storms right past me like she owns the place and empties one of her bags out onto the dining room table.
lines.zh: Maya 像这地方是她家一样从我身边大步走过，把其中一个袋子倒空在餐桌上。

lines.en: I follow behind her and join her as she sits down, taking note of the first of what I imagine will be the several thousand bento boxes required to fill her up.
lines.zh: 我跟在她身后，在她坐下时也在旁边坐下，注意到这大概会是填满她所需的几千个便当盒中的第一个。

lines.en: But as she picks up her chopsticks, her newfound fragility somehow becomes {i}more{/i} apparent in the fact that she refrains from eating.
lines.zh: 但当她拿起筷子时，她那新发现的脆弱，却因为她迟迟不动筷子而{i}愈发{/i}明显。

lines.en: I remember her saying something along the lines of how she doesn’t like to be watched, but I can’t help but feel like this is more than that.
lines.zh: 我记得她说过类似不喜欢被人看着吃饭的话，但我忍不住觉得不止于此。

lines.en: And call me self-centered, but I can’t help but feel like it is my fault.
lines.zh: 就算我自以为是吧，我还是忍不住觉得这是我的错。
: 怎么了？

lines.en: : Yes. Your ability to annoy me has become so strong that it is now capable of ruining my appetite. I hope you’re proud of yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你烦人的能力已经强到能毁掉我的胃口了。希望你为自己骄傲。

lines.en: : Good. That just gives us more time to talk.
lines.zh: : 很好。这样我们就有更多时间谈了。

lines.en: : Nevermind. I’m hungry again. Please hold your words until...tomorrow. When I am gone.
lines.zh: : 当我没说。我又饿了。请把你的话留到……明天。到我走了之后。

lines.en: : I’ll pass. It’s better we tackle this now before we have to-
lines.zh: : 免了。我们最好现在就解决，免得我们不得不——

lines.en: : Why did you tell me that...thing you told me on the beach?! And why did you almost kiss me?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要跟我说你在海滩上说的那件事？！还有你为什么差点吻我？！

lines.en: : What thing? That I’m in love with you?
lines.zh: : 什么事？说我爱上你这件事？

lines.en: : Yes! How can you say that with such a straight face?
lines.zh: : 对！你怎么能这么面不改色地说出那种话？

lines.en: : What’s with the sudden change in reaction? You seemed pretty thrilled to hear that back then. And, if I remember correctly, you were the one who moved in for a kiss first.
lines.zh: : 反应怎么突然变了？你当时听着好像还挺高兴的。而且如果我没记错的话，先凑过来要亲的是你。

lines.en: : You remember incorrectly. That doesn’t sound like a thing I would do. I’m much more reserved than that.
lines.zh: : 你记错了。那听起来不像我会做的事。我比那要矜持得多。

lines.en: : {i}Were{/i} much more reserved than that. You seem a {i}bit{/i} less reserved than normal tonight for some totally strange reason that I have no idea of.
lines.zh: : {i}是「曾经」{/i}比那矜持得多。今晚你看起来比平时放得开{i}不少{/i}，至于原因我完全想不出来，真是奇怪。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you had to go and completely change our dynamic with a few words I didn’t think I’d ever hear again.
lines.zh: : 对，因为你非得用几句我以为再也听不到的话，彻底改变了我们之间的关系。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how hard it is to keep my head on straight now? I’m supposed to be the one making us...conquer time or whatever and now all I can think about is...fireflies. And stuff.
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在要保持头脑清醒有多难吗？我本该是那个带我们……征服时间还是什么的人，可现在我满脑子都是……萤火虫。之类的东西。

lines.en: : There are three of us now, Maya. You don’t have to be the ringleader anymore. We keep trying to tell you that.
lines.zh: : 现在有三个人了，Maya。你不必再当那个领头的了。我们一直在跟你说这个。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I keep trying to tell you guys that’s just who I am. But I’m apparently as bad at explaining myself as I am at theorizing, I guess.
lines.zh: : 是啊，而我也一直在跟你们说，我就是这样的人。但显然，我解释自己的能力和理论水平一样烂，大概吧。

lines.en: : Damn it. Why did you have to invite me here? Why couldn’t we just be adults and mutually pretend that was some meaningless, fleeting moment between...acquaintances?
lines.zh: : 该死。你为什么非得叫我来这里？为什么我们不能成熟一点，互相假装那只是……熟人之间一个毫无意义的、转瞬即逝的瞬间？

lines.en: : Because I want more of those moments.
lines.zh: : 因为我想要更多那样的瞬间。
: 我想要{i}你{/i}。
: 那……别想了！

lines.en: : Do you remember what you said to me right before we almost kissed?
lines.zh: : 你还记得在我们差点接吻之前你对我说了什么吗？

lines.en: : Yes but I don’t want you to repeat it because it directly contradicts basically everything I’ve said tonight.
lines.zh: : 记得，但我不想让你重复，因为它和今晚我说过的一切基本都是矛盾的。

lines.en: : You said that if the world were to end right then, you wouldn’t care.
lines.zh: : 你说，如果世界在那一刻终结，你也无所谓。

lines.en: : I literally {i}just{/i} told you I remembered. You didn’t have to say it again.
lines.zh: : 我{i}刚{/i}才明明说了我记得。你不用再说一遍。
: 那你现在有所谓了吗？
: 你就{i}没有{/i}吗？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} might be able to say cute things now and...remember your name and...talk about stuff involving us like it’s no big deal, but one wrong move on {i}my{/i} end and this could all be over.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}现在是能说些可爱的话了，还能……想起你的名字，还能……把关于我们的事说得好像没什么大不了，但只要{i}我{/i}走错一步，这一切都可能结束。

lines.en: : Back on the beach...I lost sight of that for a second. That’s why I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 在海滩上的时候……我有那么一瞬间忘了这一点。所以我才说了那些话。

lines.en: : But when you left...I started thinking more and more about what might have happened if we followed through and...
lines.zh: : 但你走了以后……我就开始越来越想，如果我们真的做到底，会发生什么，然后……

lines.en: : And the fear of losing you {i}again{/i} outweighs anything and everything.
lines.zh: : 而{i}再{/i}次失去你的恐惧，胜过一切的一切。

lines.en: : That’s what’s been pushing me forward this whole time. Everything I’ve done and everything I do is to protect {i}you.{/i} And...obviously myself as well. But you’re a really huge part of that.
lines.zh: : 这一直是推动我前进的东西。我所做的一切、我将做的一切，都是为了保护{i}你{/i}。还有……显然也包括我自己。但你在这里面占了非常大的比重。

lines.en: : I might be a selfish, controlling know-it-all bitch, but I’m not so bad that I’d put your life at risk just because I want to kiss you. Which I obviously do because-
lines.zh: : 我也许是个自私、控制欲强、自以为是的贱人，但我也没坏到会为了想亲你而拿你的命去冒险。虽然我显然很想亲你，因为——

lines.en: : Nope! See?! I almost said it again! Look what you’re doing to me!
lines.zh: : 不！看？！我又差点说出来了！看看你把我弄成什么样了！

lines.en: : When will you let yourself be happy?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候才肯让自己幸福？

lines.en: : I should be asking {i}you{/i} when you decided to stop fighting the same fight as me.
lines.zh: : 我该问你，{i}你{/i}是什么时候决定不再和我打同一场仗的。

lines.en: : You might now be at the forefront of an inexplicable apocalyptic event, but the Sensei I know wasn’t this...{i}proactive.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你现在也许正站在一场无法解释的末日事件的最前线，但我认识的那个 Sensei 可不是这么……{i}主动{/i}的。
: 他成长了……你也该成长了。

lines.en: : Even if that means putting both myself and {i}you{/i} at risk? And everyone else? Are you really willing to risk all of that for {i}me?{/i} Why?
lines.zh: : 哪怕那意味着把我和{i}你{/i}都置于危险之中？还有其他所有人？你真的愿意为了{i}我{/i}冒这一切风险吗？为什么？

lines.en: : There are nineteen other girls in class who apparently can’t cause your mind to shut down. Just choose one of them. It’s safer.
lines.zh: : 班上还有十九个女孩，显然不会让你的大脑宕机。随便挑一个吧。那样比较安全。

lines.en: : How can you even say something like that when it’s so clear now how you feel about me?
lines.zh: : 既然现在你对我的感觉已经这么明显了，你怎么还能说出那种话？

lines.en: : Oh, it fucking {i}sucks.{/i} It’s {i}so{/i} hard to say that...but I have to.
lines.zh: : 噢，操，{i}糟透了{/i}。说出来{i}真{/i}难受……但我必须说。

lines.en: : It’s literally torture having to hear about how far you’ve gone with all of my friends while I’m stuck in the background pretending to not care. But honestly, I’ve gotten used to it.
lines.zh: : 被迫听着你和我的每一个朋友进展到了什么地步，而我却只能待在背景里假装不在乎，这简直是折磨。但说实话，我已经习惯了。

lines.en: : Even when it {i}wasn’t{/i} you it sucked, because it still kind of {i}was{/i} you in a really roundabout...physical-only sort of way.
lines.zh: : 就算那{i}不是{/i}你也一样难受，因为从某种迂回的、只关乎肉体的意义上来说，那还{i}是{/i}你。

lines.en: : You should have been mine...like you were {i}before{/i} all of this started happening.
lines.zh: : 你本该是我的……就像这一切开始{i}之前{/i}那样。

lines.en: : And you’ll probably think this is pathetic but, after several lapses in judgement and an earth-shattering amount of desperation, I...may have caved into some of my carnal desires and...broken several Senseis.
lines.zh: : 你大概会觉得这很可悲，但在几次判断失误和惊天动地的绝望之后，我……可能向自己的某些肉欲屈服了，然后……弄坏了好几个 Sensei。

lines.en: : But that’s exactly why I’m so scared of what will happen if we {i}do{/i} get closer. I’ve seen it firsthand.
lines.zh: : 但正因为如此，我才这么害怕我们{i}真的{/i}走近会发生什么。我亲眼见过。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine how breaking the {i}real{/i} you would feel after how much it hurt to break all of those {i}fake{/i} ones just because I felt alone.
lines.zh: : 只是因为觉得孤单就弄坏了那么多{i}假货{/i}，已经那么疼了，我无法想象弄坏{i}真正{/i}的你会是什么感觉。
: Maya...

lines.en: : It’s okay...I’ll go back to normal tomorrow and you can keep screwing the rest of my classmates without having to worry about hurting my feelings. It’s fine. I get that you...like them too or whatever.
lines.zh: : 没关系……我明天就会恢复正常，你可以继续去睡我其余的同学，不用担心会伤到我的感情。没关系。我明白你……也喜欢她们什么的。

lines.en: : I’m only like this tonight because {i}you{/i} wanted to talk and if I didn’t get all of this shit out of my head, I would have gone insane.
lines.zh: : 我今晚这样只是因为{i}你{/i}想谈，如果我再不把这些乱七八糟的东西从脑子里倒出来，我会疯掉的。
: 但你{i}不能{/i}爱我。
